title: The New Covenant Inaugurated: Luke
subtitle: Luke 1-24
theme: The universal scope of redemption. Good news for the poor, the outcast, and all nations.
memoryText: For the Son of Man came to seek and to save the lost.
reviewQuestions: What does the Magnificat reveal about the kind of salvation God brings?
How does Luke emphasize the role of the Holy Spirit?
What does Luke’s emphasis on prayer teach us about Jesus’ own spiritual life?
How does the road to Emmaus teach us how to read the whole Bible?
psalmsNote: Praise (113, 116, 117) and trust under pressure (27, 28, 31, 41, 55) beside Luke.
